name: Yarn Embroidery Corduroy Pencil Case
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:

- Crafted from soft corduroy fabric with a durable construction, this pencil case offers a comfortable touch, excellent durability, and a stylish textured finish. 

- The delicate yarn embroidery adds a handmade aesthetic, creating a unique and personalized look.

 

  •  Sizes & Dimensions:

- Size: 9.06 × 5.12 × 2.76 in (23 × 13 × 7 cm)
- Designed with a compact yet spacious structure, perfect for carrying daily essentials.

 

  • Embroidery Technology

- Featuring 3D yarn embroidery technology, each name or design is carefully crafted with colorful woven cotton rope details, creating a raised texture and a charming handmade appearance.
- Maximum 9 characters recommended for the best embroidery effect.

 

  • Functional & Usage:

Perfect for organizing and carrying various items, including:

- Pencils, pens, markers, and stationery

- Makeup brushes and beauty essentials

- Small accessories and everyday items

- School, office, and travel necessities

The smooth zipper and portable handle make it easy to carry and access your belongings anytime.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:

A thoughtful personalized gift for students, artists, professionals, and anyone who loves unique handmade accessories. Perfect for birthdays, back-to-school, holidays, or special occasions.

 

SPECIFICATION

Processing Time: 5-7 working days on average after payment, and all designs are updated correctly
Shipping Time: 7-15 working days on average (US)
Packaging: 1xYarn Embroidery Corduroy Pencil Case

 

NOTE

guideLine:
Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
